source.title: Apollo 11 hatch — Project Egress
source.rights: Public domain, as indicated by the Smithsonian download page
source.notes: Original assembly positions preserved. Web materials and geometry detail adapted. Group labels use source collections/materials and spatial clusters; they are an explanatory organization, not a manufacturer BOM.

windowSurround.basis: Visually confirmed central coated surround plates adjoining the window; curated into the window group.

latchAssemblies.basis: Each subgroup follows one unique source assembly parent and contains 20 colocated components.

stats.compression: Uncompressed binary glTF; geometry decimated per component. No Draco decoder required.

groups.title: Hatch structure
groups.description: The structural panel, perimeter frame and sealing surfaces.

groups.title: Window assembly
groups.description: The viewing port and surrounding frame.

groups.title: Operating handle
groups.description: The manual input that starts the hatch release mechanism.

groups.title: Gearbox & drive
groups.description: The clustered input and transmission hardware beside the hatch handle.

groups.title: Linkage network
groups.description: Rods, bell cranks and associated hardware distributed around the hatch.

groups.title: Perimeter latches
groups.description: Repeated latch assemblies positioned around the hatch perimeter.
